name: Kesztölc (Hungary)
description: White field with three diagonal stripes of blue, red and green rising from the lower centre to the upper fly, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Kesztölc: a crowned blue and red shield with a bunch of grapes, crossed hammers and a Hungarian shield, above a blue scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kesztölc arms with crown and scroll
